issues.problem: ym-jukuji explain called every reading 'a native word', but じょうず and とけい are not native words
issues.action: Reworded: the reading belongs to the pair as a block

issues.problem: ym-onkun rule 'alone = kun' left out the important exception of single kanji that are words only in their on reading (本 ほん, 駅 えき, 肉 にく, 茶 ちゃ, 絵 え); applying it mechanically gives wrong readings
issues.action: Rule now says 'usually'; added the exception with examples to explain; tip now mentions on-only words

issues.problem: ym-onkun said mountain names follow the on reading, but several use やま (立山 たてやま, 浅間山 あさまやま)
ym-rendaku rule and tip said く doubles before any hard sound, which contradicts the explain and would give がっせい for 学生
issues.action: Rule and tip now say つ/ち before k, s, t, h; く before k only

issues.problem: ym-rendaku explain said ち always doubles before k, s, t, h; it does not always (日時 にちじ)
